title: Expansion of the Family of Molecular Nanoparticles of Cerium Dioxide and Their Catalytic Scavenging of Hydroxyl Radicals

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Ce6 cerium oxide cluster, crystallized as 4·8MeNO2·2H2O

material_class.structural_family: Molecular cerium oxide cluster with a fluorite-related core

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, iron(III) nitrate hydrate, ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate, and triethylamine were added to a stirred solution of 2,6-dimethoxybenzoic acid in nitromethane. After 10 min of further stirring, the slurry was filtered. The filtrate stood undisturbed at room temperature for 2 days; the resulting yellow crystals were filtered, washed with nitromethane, and dried under vacuum.

reagents.name: Iron(III) nitrate hydrate
reagents.role: reaction additive; no Fe incorporated in the product

synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirred solution followed by standing crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter slurry; allow filtrate to stand undisturbed; filter yellow block crystals, wash with nitromethane, and dry under vacuum.

source_locations.location: Introduction; Experimental Section, synthesis of 4; Table 1
Supplied CCDC catalog row OKUMUF; Ce6 composition matches compound 4
Results and Discussion, Description of Structures; Figure 2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An all-Ce(IV) Ce6 octahedral core has its eight faces capped by a total of four μ3-oxide and four μ3-hydroxide groups; dmb ligands bridge Ce–Ce edges.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Ce19 cerium oxide cluster, crystallized as 6·3.5py·8MeCN

material_class.structural_family: Molecular mixed-valence cerium oxide cluster with a fluorite-related core

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate, benzoic acid, and ammonium iodide were added to stirred pyridine/water. The golden-yellow solution was stirred for 30 min, then acetonitrile was added. It stood undisturbed at room temperature for 3 days; yellow square-plate crystals were filtered, washed with acetonitrile, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stirred solution followed by standing crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Allow solution to stand undisturbed after acetonitrile addition; filter yellow square plates, wash with acetonitrile, and dry under vacuum.

source_locations.location: Introduction; Experimental Section, synthesis of 6; Table 1
Supplied CCDC catalog row OKUNAM; Ce19 composition matches compound 6
Results and Discussion, Description of Structures; Figure 4

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The fluorite-related Ce19 oxide/hydroxide core contains four Ce(III) ions, including a closely situated group of three.
